name: divorce-logistics
description:
Produces structured logistics checklists for the practical aspects of
divorce including financial separation steps, legal document needs,
housing transition planning, and co-parenting logistics frameworks.
Focuses exclusively on the organizational and administrative tasks
that need to happen during a divorce, not relationship assessment
or emotional counseling.
Use when the user asks about the practical steps of going through
a divorce, separating finances, or organizing co-parenting logistics.
Do NOT use for advice on whether to divorce, relationship counseling,
custody legal strategy, or emotional processing of divorce.
